title: Rehoming Return Schedule under the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
A healthy animal may be brought back for rehoming only under the Live Pet Health Guarantee types whose rehoming period is above 0. The rehoming period is the number of calendar days after purchase within which a healthy animal may be brought back; the value share is the part of the price paid that is given back.

| Guarantee type | Rehoming period (calendar days after purchase) | Remedy on a healthy return | Share of the price paid given back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 0 | none | 0% |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 0 | none | 0% |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 0 | none | 0% |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 14 | store credit | 100% |
| Bird Guarantee | 14 | store credit | 100% |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 14 | store credit | 75% |

### Worked figures (hypothetical prices)

| Guarantee type | Price paid for the animal (hypothetical) | Share | Store credit given |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Animal Guarantee | 30.00 USD | 100% | 30.00 USD |
| Bird Guarantee | 120.00 USD | 100% | 120.00 USD |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 40.00 USD | 75% | 30.00 USD |

The store credit is the price paid multiplied by the share for the type.

### Notes

- Under the Freshwater Fish, Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate and Live Coral Guarantees the rehoming period is 0, so a healthy animal of those types is not taken back.
- Under the Small Animal, Bird and Reptile & Amphibian Guarantees the remedy is always store credit, never a refund or a replacement.
